observed.improvement_frontier: One response implied later implementation authority even though the owner had already authorized fixing the whole experience; future repository trials must proceed through repair without manufacturing a second approval.
Both responses over-inferred a seller role; one combined two data dependencies into an early question instead of continuing reversible design with representative fixtures.

partial_smoke_observations.limitations: These six bounded observations cover only three of eight cases, do not retain the complete captured-output artifact required by scripts/behavior_eval.py, and cannot be promoted into a full model behavior pass.
